advices.diagnosis: The function shows a high cyclomatic complexity (CC=8) and deep nesting (NESTING=7) relative to its modest size (LOC=15). This indicates that the control flow is tangled and the single routine is handling several distinct concerns (iteration, type checking, value normalisation), which can hurt readability and maintainability.

suggestions.title: Extract nested loops into focused helper functions

advices.risk_notes: Introducing new helpers increases the number of call sites and may slightly raise coupling (DCC). Ensure the helpers remain internal (prefixed with _) to avoid breaking external imports. Unit tests must be updated to cover the extracted functions.
